description: Grouped splits and dataset identities of task T041. Every valid row states the identity, the group assignments, and the split identities that the Rust core computes, with the content hashes of the dataset domain and the split domain. Every invalid row states the reason code and the field path of its rejection. The evidence rows state the validation evidence classification, and the overlap rows state the fitting and validation overlap, under the declared grouping strategy.

metadata.sampling_method: Sampled at random from reviewed traffic of one week.

valid.note: Two groups of two records. The fitting split holds the group dates, the validation split holds the group limits, and one group appears in one split only.

evidence.note: One fresh validation split of one representative sample is independent validation evidence.
The same holdout that one earlier claim consumed is development data, and one new claim needs fresh validation evidence.
One renamed split of one other dataset that holds the same records is the same holdout: the content hash decides, not the names.
One targeted synthetic challenge set supports no qualification claim and states no prevalence, whatever its size.
One split without records carries no evidence.

overlap.note: The two splits of one dataset share no group and no case.
One group name that two datasets declare is overlap of the declared grouping strategy.
One case identifier that two datasets hold is one duplicated case that supplied fitting and validation evidence.
